headline: Federal executive agencies closed for half of the workday on Thursday, December 24, 2009, Christmas Eve.
what_it_does: This executive order closed federal executive departments and agencies for half of the workday on Christmas Eve, December 24, 2009. It gave many federal workers part of that day off. The title does not give further details, such as which half of the day was closed or whether any workers had to stay on duty.

who_it_affects.how: Many got a half day off from work on December 24, 2009.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal agency services
who_it_affects.how: Federal offices were likely open for only part of the day on December 24, 2009.
